Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You have an overclocked tech minion.

You channel energy from your overclocked tech minion into your spell database. If your next action is to Cast a Spell, you siphon surplus magical energy to cause your overclocked minion to Stride and erupt in a burst of flames and lightning after the spell resolves. It deals 3d4 fire and @Damage[3d4[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] (basic Reflex save against your spell DC) and is destroyed. At 12th level and every two levels thereafter, increase the fire and electricity damage you deal by 1d4.
